verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's EC/VC page says the dedicated team serves both high-growth companies and venture capital and growth equity investors through the full lifecycle. The venture debt practice also acts for both lenders and borrowers and helped develop loan documentation for leading European lenders. It advises on term sheets, valuation mechanics and investor rights, which implies familiarity with market terms from both sides. Missing for 10: a named fund- or investor-side case study (the cited N26 matter is company-side), any published market-terms report or benchmarking data, and independent corroboration of its two-sided market knowledge.
